recognize_zh: 低倍視野中許多紅血球內可見細小環狀與點狀寄生蟲，部分紅血球含多個蟲體，紅血球間亦散佈小型蟲體，未見瘧色素或配子體，符合巴貝西蟲（Babesia）感染。
features: Many red cells containing small intraerythrocytic ring and dot forms
Several red cells harboring more than one parasite
Small extracellular forms between red cells (some may be platelets)
No pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; red cell size normal
Tetrads not resolvable at this magnification
Single small lymphocyte in the field
describe_en: Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear viewed at low magnification shows numerous red cells containing small intraerythrocytic ring and dot-like organisms, several red cells harboring multiple parasites. Small extracellular forms are present between red cells, some of which may be platelets. Infected red cells are normal in size, and no hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes are identified; tetrads cannot be resolved at this power. A single small lymphocyte is present. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection; high-power examination for tetrads, parasitemia quantification and PCR are recommended.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum shows appliqué and double-chromatin rings with possible banana-shaped gametocytes or pigment and no extracellular forms or tetrads.
Overlying platelets are granular with a surrounding halo and are not ring-shaped within the red cell plane.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single dense round inclusions, usually one per cell, without a pale central vacuole.
